download.title: Open the file’s menu
download.text: Find MedicareCorsair.exe. Click the three dots beside it.

download.title: Choose Keep
download.text: Choose Keep only for this file from our GitHub release.
download.label: Keep

download.title: Expand the warning
download.text: Click Show more. In some versions, click the small arrow beside Delete instead.
download.label: Show more  ▾

download.title: Choose Keep anyway
download.text: If the warning is about an unfamiliar file and you trust this download, choose Keep anyway. Stop if it reports malware.
download.label: Keep anyway

install.title: Turn on Developer mode
install.text: On the Extensions page we opened, look near the bottom of the left sidebar. Click the switch beside Developer mode so it turns on.
install.label: Developer mode

install.title: Click Load unpacked
install.text: Look at the top of the Extensions page. Click Load unpacked.
install.label: Load unpacked

download.title: Review the download
download.text: Find MedicareCorsair.exe and click its warning or menu. If it is marked unfamiliar and you trust this GitHub download, choose the option to keep it. Stop if it reports malware.
download.label: MedicareCorsair.exe  ⋯

download.title: Open the app
download.text: Once the download finishes, click MedicareCorsair.exe.
download.label: MedicareCorsair.exe

install.title: Turn on Developer mode
install.text: On the Extensions page we opened, look in the top-right corner. Click the switch beside Developer mode so it turns on.
install.label: Developer mode

install.title: Click Load unpacked
install.text: A row of buttons appears near the top-left. Click Load unpacked.
install.label: Load unpacked

download.title: Open Downloads
download.text: Click the download arrow in the Firefox toolbar.
download.label: Downloads ↓

download.title: Review and open the file
download.text: Find MedicareCorsair.exe. Review any warning and open only if you trust this GitHub download. Stop if it reports malware.
download.label: MedicareCorsair.exe

install.title: Choose This Firefox
install.text: On the page we opened, click This Firefox in the left sidebar if it is not already selected.
install.label: This Firefox

install.title: Load the add-on
install.text: Click Load Temporary Add-on near the top of the page.
install.label: Load Temporary Add-on
